svg.text: Along each ray from 0, gcd counts 1, 2, 3, …; the set takes 4
Numbers in circles: gcd of that cell.
On the ray through a primitive (p, q)
(gcd(p, q) = 1) the cells are k·(p, q),
So every ray holds exactly one cell with
gcd = 4: the cell k = 4. The shaded set
is one cell per ray, a "transversal".
shaded cell inside 0…20; each has one.
